title: Start the online application
description: Create a username and password in the application portal.
required_action: Open the portal and create an account.

title: Complete the application
description: Enter personal, academic and programme information and upload requested documents.
required_action: Fill all required fields and submit documents.

title: Admissions tests
description: Eligible applicants proceed to admissions tests according to programme requirements.

title: Interview, video and extracurricular review
description: The third assessment stage includes personal interview, introductory video and extracurricular activities.
required_action: Attend interview and provide video/certificates when requested.

title: Conditional admission and document verification
description: Successful applicants receive conditional admission and must provide certified physical documents.
required_action: Submit original/certified documents to Admission and Registration.
